title: T 204 potato: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: T 204 potato: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: T 204 potato is a potato variety. 16.4 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits. Compare it with others. Free guide. In plain words.
excerpt: T 204 is a registered potato variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1989. Its record notes 16.4 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

heroImage.alt: Vegetable terraces and plastic tunnels on the slopes of Mankayan, Benguet, the kind of farm where T 204 potato is grown

blocks.text: The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry. Compare it with the others in our [potato variety finder](/crop-varieties/potato), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [vegetables in the Philippines](/crops/vegetables-philippines).

items: **Yield:** 16.4 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Its average yield of 16.4 t/ha trails the average of its group, 21.79. It sits in the lower quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions
rows: Took some damage but held up

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [late blight](/diseases/late-blight).

The pests and diseases that hit potato fields most often: [early blight](/diseases/early-blight), [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [leafminer](/pests/leafminer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its roots have light yellow flesh and salmon color skin.
Where and when to plant T 204 potato

It suits lowland areas. Potato grows in the cool highlands of Benguet, Mountain Province and Bukidnon. Plant clean seed tubers, and pick a variety rated against late blight for the wet season. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for root crops](/land-preparation/root-crop-land-preparation).

items.q: Where can I buy seed of T 204?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
